_comment: Video sources for the match. 'videos' are broadcast highlights on YouTube. Each clip ties a stretch of the video (start/end in seconds) to one goal in the match events CSV, keyed by the Goal event's Period and MatchClock (seconds into the period). The backend refuses to start if a clip points to a goal that is not in the data. Clip times were read off the video's preview frames (2 s apart) by matching the on-screen clock and score to the event data, so they can be off by a second or two; fine-tune them while watching. The video is embedded with the official YouTube player from the organizer's own channel; downloading, re-cutting or re-hosting it is NOT cleared.

videos.title: Highlights | U.S. Collegiate Selects vs. HC Davos | FINAL | Spengler Cup Davos 2025
videos.permission: Official highlights, embedded with the YouTube player from the Spengler Cup Davos channel. Not downloaded or re-edited.

recording._comment: Full-game arena camera recording (not in git: it is 13.7 GB). backend/scripts/cut_clips.py cuts one short clip per card-player event from it into backend/media/clips/<event Timestamp>.mp4 (also not in git). Video second = event Timestamp in seconds - timestamp_offset. The offset was measured by lining up the crowd-noise peaks in the audio with the 9 goals: each period on its own gave the same value (+-1 s), so the recording has no cuts. Then checked on frames at three goals. 'windows' are seconds before/after the event that each clip covers.
recording.title: Arena camera 1, full game recording
